cold_start.tool: adb shell am force-stop then am start -W
cold_start.scope: Initial activity display, not restored terminal readiness; page cache was not dropped.

frame_samples.tool: dumpsys gfxinfo framestats, global modern jank counters after reset
frame_samples.scope: Live connected terminal; animated working indicator/title. Activity includes sheet opening, scrolling, background window and refreshes; uncontrolled server workload.

metadata_microbenchmark.environment: Optimized Rust release build on development Mac, not S22+
metadata_microbenchmark.workload: Publish and encode one changed title with 256 cached activity records; no terminal frame
metadata_microbenchmark.command: GHOSTTY_PREFIX="$PWD/.build/ghostty-host" CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/.build/rust" cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --workspace activity_metadata_publish_benchmark -- --ignored --nocapture
metadata_microbenchmark.scope: Opening Activity still sends cached reports immediately; background scans remain disabled when closed. No whole-app speedup claim.

review_findings.finding: Cached activity was cloned/serialized on every changing-title metadata publication even while hidden. Omit the hidden catalog from JNI metadata while retaining it natively for instant reopening.
Activity has higher observed jank than the no-touch terminal sample. Trace sheet transitions, list layout and concurrent title/working-indicator rendering before choosing the next change.

Visible live-terminal top samples reached roughly 92–96% of one CPU core. Subsequent thread samples were taken after the device stopped drawing and cannot establish attribution. A controlled foreground trace is required; no battery-life claim.

limits: Four cold launches are a small sample and do not measure network restoration.
Frame samples are observations, not controlled before/after optimization comparisons.
Metadata timings are a host microbenchmark, not phone CPU timings.
No physical key-to-pixel latency or battery-drain measurement was performed.
No user terminal input, ownership changes or server configuration changes were made during phone profiling.
